text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"To experience such a magnificent concerto...
What a truly wonderful day this is!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's armonia layered together perfectly with my melodia!
My heart trembled at such unparalleled beauty in harmony!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear it too?
The ceaseless applause and cheers of the spettatori!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The applause you receive as primo violino is truly something special!
So very, very much so...!!
choice_data_list: Don't you think you can take your performance to an even higher level?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
The resonance of victory keeps echoing deep in my ears,
and it doesn't feel like it'll stop ringing anytime soon...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Let us savor this joy and honor together...
to our hearts' content!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, an even more magnificent concerto.
Let us strive for an unknown, supreme armonia!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Just imagining what kind of musica the next one will be
gets me so excited I can hardly bear it...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: To do that, I've got to hone my skills diligently!
